title: Ask for answers you can verify

body.text: When asking about current topics, also request
— like 'summarize with source links' so you can check further — and specify a clear time frame like 'this week' so old data doesn't mix in.

example: Summarize 5 key tech news items this week, with a source link for each.

title: Dig deeper continuously

body.text: You can keep asking as a conversation — have it expand on a point you care about, or compare multiple viewpoints. Asking step by step gives deeper, more on-target answers than one all-in-one question.

example: Expand on point 3 in detail, and tell me what differing opinions there are.
